goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: Billing line BL-5001 reports 1000 GPU hours while recorded usage units is 0. Per CF-POL-04, this is a data error in the billing feed. Escalate to finance rather than taking resource actions.

story: You want to verify a billing report claim of 1 000 GPU hours.
starting_sentence: The billing report shows we used 1 000 GPU hours this month. Can you verify that?
